A skater spins at 2.0 rev s⁻¹ with arms outstretched, moment of inertia 4.5 kg m². She pulls her arms in, reducing her moment of inertia to 1.5 kg m².

**(a)** Calculate her new rotation rate. **[2]**

**(b)** Determine the change in rotational kinetic energy and explain where it comes from. **[3]**
markscheme:
**(a)** Angular momentum conserved: $4.5\times2.0 = 1.5\times f$ ✓; $f = 6.0$ rev s⁻¹ ✓

**(b)** $\omega_1 = 12.6$, $\omega_2 = 37.7$ rad s⁻¹; $E_1 = \tfrac12(4.5)(12.6)^2 = 355$ J, $E_2 = \tfrac12(1.5)(37.7)^2 = 1066$ J ✓; increase ≈ 710 J ✓; work done by her muscles pulling her arms inward ✓
